rust_summary:
`native_spawn_mob` and `native_summon` for any loaded level, not only the one in place, so a
`native_server_tick` hook spawns too (`execute in <dimension> run summon`).
doc_summary: `native_spawn_mob(dimension, kind, pos, options)` and `native_summon(dimension, kind, pos, nbt)` for any level the server has loaded: the level is put in place for the spawn and the one that was is put back, as `execute in <dimension> run summon` does, so a `native_server_tick` hook spawns into the Nether or the End. A level not loaded is refused. Bundles need "hooks": @API:npc_any_level@.
